filename.description: Markdown file, relative to the first input directory or to the config file.

title.description: Browser title of the generated site.

url.description: Prefix shown before every endpoint path, e.g. https://api.example.com.

sampleUrl.description: Prefix for relative @apiSampleRequest URLs; true uses the origin the docs are served from.

order.description: Group and endpoint names (@apiGroup / @apiName) in display order.

header.description: Markdown file shown before the endpoints.

footer.description: Markdown file shown after the endpoints.

input.description: Source directories. Applied only when apidoc runs with -c and no -i.

output.description: Output directory. Not honoured by the apidoc CLI, which always passes its own -o; use -o.

auth.description: Credentials the sample requests can send. An Authorize button stores them for the tab; endpoints with @apiPermission none do not send them.

name.description: Name shown in the Authorize dialog.

type.description: bearer: Authorization: Bearer <token>. apiKey: a header or query parameter. basic: Authorization: Basic.

header.description: bearer only: header that carries the token. Default Authorization.

prefix.description: bearer only: word before the token. Default Bearer.

in.description: apiKey only: where the key goes. Default header.

param.description: apiKey only: name of the header or query parameter. Default X-API-Key.

environments.description: Base URLs for the sample requests, shown as a selector. The first one is the default. The URL goes in front of the path, in place of sampleUrl.

name.description: Name shown in the selector, such as Sandbox.

aloneDisplay.description: Show one endpoint at a time instead of the whole page.

codeSamples.description: Show cURL, JavaScript and Python samples under each endpoint.

forceLanguage.description: Force the interface language instead of the browser language.
